name: nightowl
description: Nightowl for Windows: keep your PC awake from the system tray and monitor Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity sessions.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:electron && npm run build:ui
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron . --dev"
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
